seoTitle: RSS Feed Generator: Build RSS 2.0 XML from a List
metaDescription: Create a valid RSS 2.0 feed from lines of title, URL, date and summary, with escaped content and an atom:link self reference.
intro: Write your posts as simple lines and get a complete RSS 2.0 file to host on your site.
why:
Each line has the form "title | URL | YYYY-MM-DD | summary". The generator validates the URLs, converts the dates to RFC 822 form, uses each URL as a permalink GUID, escapes special characters and adds the channel details you fill in (title, site URL, description, language, feed URL). The result can be saved as feed.xml.

For a site with many posts it is better to generate the feed from your CMS or static-site generator; this tool is for small sites, tests and examples. Check the output with the RSS validator.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Fill in the feed title, site URL, description and feed URL.
Copy the XML into feed.xml on your site.
Link it with <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml" href="/feed.xml">.
